name: skillsbento
description: Free agent skills as installable plugins: analytics, research and livestream-to-content workflows for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: product-launch-suite
plugins.description: Generates a complete product launch document suite from a product name and description: Business & Market Strategy, Competitive Landscape & Feasibility, Product Roadmap & Partnerships, and a Sales Deck, backed by live web research.

plugins.name: product-sales-analysis
plugins.description: Analyzes sales/ecommerce CSV data and generates an interactive HTML dashboard with KPIs, category performance, YoY growth trends, marketing ROI and prioritized recommendations.

plugins.name: social-media-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyzes social media performance data (Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok) from CSV/Excel exports: engagement rate, follow conversion, viral content patterns, and a React dashboard with strategic recommendations.

plugins.name: stock-analyzer
plugins.description: Stock analysis combining chart pattern recognition, live news research and technical signal scoring. Generates a downloadable interactive HTML report with a tabbed layout and a position sizing calculator. Not financial advice.

plugins.name: x-twitter-stats-analyzer
plugins.description: Dedicated X (Twitter) analytics skill. Ingests X analytics exports and produces engagement composition analysis, growth funnel breakdowns, posting frequency insights and an interactive React dashboard.

plugins.name: stream-shorts
plugins.description: Livestream to content pipeline in one skill: standard folder layout, transcripts, per-feature clips, chapters, subtitles, summary reels and animated 9:16 shorts (split-screen camera, captions, frame-0 hook, real footage), with YouTube titles and descriptions. Every video is versioned and reproducible.
